topic: Street cricket: winning and losing while staying friends.

episode.title: Gali Cricket: Jeet Se Barh Kar Dosti

shots.narration: آج گلی کے کرکٹ میں کون جیتے گا؟
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, colourful Pakistani residential lane beside a courtyard entrance and neem tree, soft sunlight, rounded 3D family-film style. No traffic, writing, signs or logos.
shots.action: Mano, a white kitten with orange patches, blue eyes and a bell on a red ribbon, raises a small plain cricket bat beside Sheru, a brown desi dog with a white chest, pointy ears and a green collar.
shots.mood: Playful anticipation, bright eyes and warm colours.

shots.narration: دونوں نے طے کیا، لکیر پار کرنے والا جیتے گا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, the same empty Pakistani lane, a plain cricket bat and soft orange ball beside Mano, no writing or logos.
shots.action: Sheru lays a short blue rope flat across the lane as a boundary.
shots.mood: Friendly agreement, relaxed smiles, soft sunlight.

shots.narration: [excited] پہلے مانو نے زور سے گیند ماری!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, batting spot in the same colourful lane, blue rope boundary visible farther down, no writing or logos.
shots.action: Mano strikes the soft orange ball with the small plain bat.
shots.mood: Energetic delight, wide blue eyes, lifted ears.

shots.narration: ارے، گیند تو لکیر سے پہلے ہی رک گئی۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, ground-level view of the blue rope boundary in the empty lane, Mano visible behind it, no writing or logos.
shots.action: The soft orange ball rolls to a stop just short of the blue rope.
shots.mood: Gentle disappointment, Mano's ears slightly lowered.

shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, original batting spot beside pastel courtyard walls, orange ball resting nearby, no writing or logos.
shots.action: Mano hands the small plain cricket bat to Sheru.

shots.narration: [excited] شیرو نے بھی خوب شاٹ لگایا!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, same batting spot and distant blue rope boundary, sunny empty Pakistani lane, no writing or logos.
shots.action: Sheru strikes the soft orange ball with the small plain bat.
shots.mood: Joyful effort, focused eyes and perked ears.

shots.narration: گیند لکیر پار گئی، شیرو جیت گیا!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, clear view across the blue rope boundary, Mano and Sheru watching from the batting spot behind it, no writing or logos.
shots.action: The orange ball rolls across the blue rope.
shots.mood: Clear victory, Sheru smiling and Mano looking disappointed.

shots.narration: مانو ہار کر منہ پھلا کر بیٹھ گئی۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, low doorstep beside the same lane and courtyard entrance, neem leaves overhead, no writing or logos.
shots.action: Mano sits on the doorstep with her face turned away from the cricket game.
shots.mood: Mild sulking, puffed cheeks, gentle and never distressing.

shots.narration: [whispers] شیرو بولا، تمہارے بغیر کھیل کا مزہ ہی نہیں۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, the shaded doorstep beside the colourful lane, no writing or logos.
shots.action: Sheru offers the small plain cricket bat to seated Mano.
shots.mood: Kind reassurance, Sheru's soft smile and Mano's curious glance.

shots.narration: مانو بولی، تم اچھا کھیلے، مبارک ہو!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, same doorstep with warm sunlight along the pastel wall, no writing or logos.
shots.action: Mano accepts the cricket bat from Sheru.
shots.mood: Genuine congratulations, bright smiles and relaxed ears.

shots.narration: دونوں پھر ہنسی خوشی کھیلنے کو تیار تھے۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, same empty lane, bat resting beside the orange ball, blue rope boundary in the distance, no writing or logos.
shots.action: Mano and Sheru share a friendly paw bump.
shots.mood: Warm friendship, cheerful faces, golden sunlight.

shots.narration: [excited] دوستی جیت سے بڑھ کر ہے؛ کل پتنگ اڑائیں گے!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, colourful Pakistani courtyard beneath a neem tree, cricket bat and ball beside a plain diamond kite with no writing, loose undecorated string spool nearby, no signs or logos.
shots.action: Mano points toward the plain colourful kite beside Sheru.
shots.mood: Happy friendship and eager anticipation for tomorrow.

episode.endHook: Agli baar Mano aur Sheru patang urayenge!
episode.description: مانو اور شیرو نے محلے کی گلی میں کرکٹ کھیلی، مگر ہار کر مانو ناراض ہو گئی۔ دیکھیے دونوں نے کیسے جانا کہ دوستی جیت سے بڑھ کر ہے!
